title: Public content on the IPFS network; local/offline exchange; gateway caching
description: Lower priority: publish public Space records, public broadcast channels and CORUNDUM public posts to the public IPFS network (privacy-free because public by choice); device-to-device blob exchange on LAN or disconnected settings (radio-mesh gateways); any gateway/CDN may serve CIDs since content self-verifies.
close_reason: Public IPFS and gateways covered by 10.4.4; member-to-member and LAN exchange ruled out (Mark 2026-10-17, A)
